memory_candidates.content: In this repo, a consolidation target protected by a #guard_msgs-gated `#print axioms` block is specified by its axiom profile, not just its statement. Tests/BimodalTest/Semantics/SaturationFiniteAxiomTest.lean pins four such profiles and its own prose names the wrong consolidation ('route the subsingleton case through the general lemma'). When planning a helper that subsumes such a site, the helper must be ADDITIVE: added beside the guarded lemma, never routed through it, and never routed through a helper whose `classical`/`by_cases` opening drags in Classical.choice. A direct proof can be both shorter and strictly cleaner axiomatically than reuse -- measured here: saturation_of_fib_subsingleton is [propext]-only, while the existing univ_or_singleton route is Classical.choice-dependent. Generalisation: when a test pins a non-functional property (axiom profile, allocation count, elaboration time), treat DRY consolidation as constrained by that property, and verify the profile rather than the build.
